info.name: 1Factory API
Part Master
1Factory Gets a List of Part Masters for Your Organization.

params.name: page
params.description: Starting page for queried rows - defaults to 0 (the start of the list). Returned rows will start at index (page * page_size).

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of records to return from the query. Defaults to 100, maximum value 500.

params.name: part_number
params.description: Part name / number to filter on.

params.name: rev
params.description: Part rev to filter on. Typically used in conjunction with the part_number query parameter.

params.name: parent_part_number
params.description: Parent Part number to filter on for Table of Size entries.

params.name: parent_rev
params.description: Parent Part rev to filter on for Table of Size entries.

params.name: is_library
params.description: If the part is a configured as a library.

params.name: is_assembly
params.description: If the part is a configured as an assembly.

params.name: is_itar
params.description: If the part is a configured as an ITAR part.

params.name: has_ppap
params.description: If the part has any PPAP documents.

params.name: type
params.description: If the part has any PPAP documents.

params.name: project_identifier
params.description:
Name of project_identifier to filter on. Must come from your organization's Part Master Project Identifier LOV. 

(The name used in the UI for this LOV is configured in your organization's Part Master settings and might not be 'Project Identifier').

params.name: status
params.description: Status to filter on.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Return objects created after the specified date-time

params.name: created_before
params.description: Return objects created before the specified date-time

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return objects updated after the specified date-time

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Return objects updated before the specified date-time

items.docs:
The list of part master entries that can be filtered by specifying query parameters. 
 Paging parameters control the number of rows of part master objects returned. By default, the first 100 part masters are returned.

info.name: 1Factory Creates a New (or Updates Existing) Part Master Entry for Your Organization.

items.docs:
Create a new part master entry that can be used when referring to parts when creating Plans, Inspections, FAIs etc. 

 The part number and rev must be unique - if a part master with the same part number and revision already exists, the existing Part Master entry will be overwritten.

info.name: 1Factory Defines Assembly Relationships Between Part Masters.

items.docs: Defines (or replaces) the list of parts that make up an assembly part. All referenced part numbers & revisions must already exist as Part Master entries.

info.name: Work Orders
1Factory Updates the List of Manufacturing Work Order Numbers for Your Organization.

items.docs:
Defines the current list of manufacturing work orders for your organization. If a work order list already exists, this request will overwrite it.

This list will be used to provide suggested values for manufacturing inspection identifiers in the 1Factory application, for example, when creating a new inspection. 

It will also pre-populate the lot size for inspections created using an inspection identifier in this list, if the corresponding list entry has a lot size.
